data.one_liner: Liquid Glass for Flutter with refraction, blur, tint, and shared capture.
data.what_it_does: Provides a performant Liquid Glass UI implementation for Flutter using a shared capture host. It offers glass refraction, blur, tints, rims, and a suite of UI components like bars, tabs, switches, sliders, menus, sheets, and dialogs.
use_when: You want glassmorphic UI components with high performance and shared background captures.
Your app targets Flutter 3.47 or later and requires liquid glass finishes.
avoid_when: You need to support older versions of Flutter below 3.47.
You prefer standard Material Design widgets without glass styling.
strengths: Shares a single capture atlas across multiple glass components to optimize GPU cost.
Skips capture updates when underlying content hasn't changed.
Includes a rich set of drop-in glass widgets like bars, tabs, switches, and alerts.
weaknesses: API is in the 0.x stage and minor version changes may require code updates.
Relies heavily on recent Flutter and Impeller engine capabilities for best performance.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency via pub add and place a GlassHost above your navigator.
